overview: Blood Connect is a blood donor matchmaking app where registered donors manage their availability status and seekers can publicly search for nearby donors by blood type — no login needed for seekers. Donors are automatically marked available again 4 months after their last donation. A medical instrument shop directory is also included.
features: Donor registration and login via Internet Identity
Public donor search by blood type — no login required
Donor profile cards with name, address, blood type, and contact
Medical instrument shop directory with external links
